mentions.name: FunSketch
mentions.description: This website lets children (of all ages) easily draw a sketch and then bring it to life using AI and a prompt. It accepts creative submissions and will be featured at an art festival so kids can take a more active role.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the holidays I built a simple website which lets children (of all ages) easily draw something and then bring the sketch to life using AI and a prompt.
